title: Quatrains of Nostradamus
summary: The Quatrains of Nostradamus are a set of fifty prophecies made by ancient Casterwill seer Nostradamus. They would help the Huntik Foundation to uncover the hidden powers and Titans of the Casterwill family, and help protect humanity against the Blood Spiral and the Nullifiers.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Eathon Lambert hid away the prophecies in his Holotome. The Huntik Foundation was able to decipher them after recovering Nostradamus' scrying glass. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

The final prophecy recovered in Nostradamus' Tomb turned out to be a fake created by The Betrayer to trick Lok Lambert into breaking the seal of the Spiral Mark with the Willblade, and set the Red Comet to hit Earth. [S2E49]

Ultimately, a real quatrain of Nostradamus' was used to defeat him for good. [Dante's Return]
